angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 313,065 km at 35.07 pc = 0.12 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 28.5123 +/- 0.0184 mas (same row, RUWE 1.23): 35.07 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.45 +/- 0.013 solar radii from Cloutier et al. 2021, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1634 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....162...79C/abstract): 313,065 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.502 +/- 0.014 solar masses from Cloutier et al. 2021, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1634 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....162...79C/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3550 +/- 69 K from Cloutier et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1634 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....162...79C/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Cloutier et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1634 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....162...79C/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-1634.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.832, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1634 (pscomppars): spectral type M2, from Cloutier et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....162...79C/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, PM J03455+3706: main object type Em*, Emission-line Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1634 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.19 dex, from Hirano et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....162..161H/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1634 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.5784, from Hirano et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....162..161H/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1634 (pscomppars): rotation period 77 d, from Palethorpe et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.548ag520P/abstract)
